records.title: Tourism Sector Projects
details:
Out of the total 52 projects, major components of 9 projects are
physically complete. The remaining projects launched under Swadesh
Darshan 2.0 and ‘Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual, Heritage,
Augmentation Drive (PRASHAD)’ schemes are under various stages of
implementation. The details of the 52 projects are at Annexure-I.
